sentences.text:
on 13 September, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.12191 of 2014
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
"....to issue an appropriate Writ order or direction more particularly in the nature of Writ of Mandamus and declaring the action of Respondent No.1 in not paying compensation relating to an extent of Ac.0.18 guntas land in Survey No.113 situated in Murmoor (V), Ramagundam Mandal, Karimnagar District as highly illegal,
arbitrary and contrary to law and clear violation of Articles 14, 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and clear violation of Principles of Natural Justice and consequently to direct the respondent No.1 to pay compensation amount pertaining an extent of Ac.0.18 guntas in Survey No.113 situated in Murmoor (V), Ramagundam Mandal, Karimnagar District along with interest and pass..."
2.
The case of the petitioner is that he is the absolute owner and possessor of the land to an extent of Ac.0.18 gts. in Sy.No.113, situated at Murmoor Village, Ramagundam Mandal, Karimnagar District.

It is the further case of the petitioner that his brother instituted a suit vide O.S.No.97 of 2008 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge, Peddapalli, claiming right over the said property and the said suit was dismissed conferring rights to the petitioner over the subject property and the petitioner is in enjoyment of the said property as absolute owner and possessor from the date of dismissal of the said suit.
It is the further case of the petitioner that the respondents have acquired the said 2 CVBR,J wp_12191_2014 land for the purpose of Sripada Sagar Project, Ellampalli.

The grievance of the petitioner is that in view of the pendency of the suit instituted by his brother vide O.S.No.97 of 2008 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge, Peddapalli, the respondents have not examined the claim of the petitioner and not paid the compensation to the petitioner under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, "the Act").
3.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents submitted that the petitioner has not submitted any document to establish his title over the property to an extent of Ac.0.18 gts. in Sy.No.113, situated at Murmoor Village, Ramagundam Mandal,
Karimnagar District.

On receipt of such documents, the respondents are directed to examine the claim of the petitioner and pass appropriate orders in accordance with the 3 A. Lakshminarayana, vs The Land Acquisition Officer Special ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91684212/
1 CVBR,J wp_12191_2014 provisions of the Act, within a period of twelve (12) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and communicate the decision thereon to the petitioner.
5. With the above observations, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
